title: security: rbac-v2 enforce kms region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Martinez
description: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region residency constraints and harden audit logging for sensitive workspace operations. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require strict KMS residency and immutable audit trails; existing rbac-v2 allowed KMS keys from non-resident regions in some edge workflows and audit events were missing contextual metadata for cross-tenant admin actions. Changes include: policy enforcement in the control-plane RBAC evaluator, server-side KMS residency validation when creating or updating encryption bindings, expanded audit events with kms_key_id and effective_region fields, and a migration path that emits audit warnings before enforcement. Testing: unit tests for evaluator rules, integration tests exercising VPC/private deployments, e2e upgrade test that validates warning->enforce rollout. Checklist: - [x] Implement residency validation in rbac-evaluator - [x] Add audit fields and ensure logback/structured sinks include new fields - [x] Add migration flag and warning mode for 2 weeks - [x] Update rbac-policy-bundle docs and examples - [x] Add Linear tickets and slack announcements - [x] CI green, security review approved Rollout plan: feature flag gated enforcement, 2-week warning period with telemetry, auto-enforce after opt-in unless customer requests extended migration. Related: ENG-4682, SEC-1020, SUP-2123. See commits and changed files for details.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency for RBAC v2 bindings with a 2-week warning period; expanded audit logging to include kms_key_id and effective_region; feature-flag gated rollout; updates to rbac-policy-bundle and docs; provides migration path and telemetry for customers.
summary: Enforce KMS region residency in RBAC v2 and harden audit logging with migration/warning flow and documentation updates.
